_comment: Announced Global release dates for JP-ahead support-card records (P5). Added 2026-08-12; same rationale as uma_release_overrides.json (provenance §1.3 — the upstream cutover feed is gone, so a pin bump can no longer flip these). Records stay server:'jp'; this file only dates them. Source: uma.guide August 2026 release schedule (https://uma.guide/guides/release-schedule-august26), cross-checked against Game8. Dates are banner-open dates. DELIBERATELY OMITTED (P3 — do not add without a source): (a) the [Tracen Academy] R companions 10079 Daiichi Ruby / 10080 K.S. Miracle, which our data projects on the same day and which conventionally ship with their character, but which neither source names — an unsourced date would be fabricated precision; (b) Tanino Gimlet 30145 [Welcome to Umayuru] + 10084, which both sources hedge as 'expected August 31' for the Umayuru campaign rather than announcing. Reruns (Smart Falcon, Silence Suzuka, Fine Motion, Maruzensky) need nothing — already server:'global'.
